assumptions.choice: Construct 1-hour candles internally by aggregating the supplied 1-minute OHLC bars.
assumptions.reason: The harness supplies only one 1-minute data feed and does not provide a separate 1-hour feed.

assumptions.choice: A bullish FVG is recorded when the first candle high is below the third candle low; a bearish FVG is recorded when the first candle low is above the third candle high. The zone is bounded by those non-overlapping outer-candle extremes.
assumptions.reason: This is the literal three-consecutive-candle non-overlap implementation of the stated FVG definition.

assumptions.choice: A clear upward main trend requires the last three completed 1-hour closes to be strictly increasing.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires a main trend and excludes strong sideways movement but supplies no numerical trend definition.

assumptions.choice: The last 1-minute candle whose body is at least 70% of its high-low range supplies the significant Order Block high; an upward close above that high is the strong upward continuation and break confirmation.
assumptions.reason: The 70% body criterion is stated, while 'strong price move' has no separate threshold.

assumptions.choice: Once any recorded 1-hour FVG is touched or entered by a 1-minute bar, the touch remains valid until a trade closes or an entry attempt is rejected.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires retracement to an FVG before the Order Block break but does not give an expiry interval.

assumptions.choice: Use the lower boundary of the nearest recorded 1-hour FVG whose entire zone begins above the filled entry price.
assumptions.reason: A FVG is a zone rather than one price; its lower boundary is the first level reached from below.

assumptions.choice: Risk 1% of current account value per trade, using entry-price-to-stop distance and limiting size to available cash.
assumptions.reason: The specification directs a fixed 1-2% capital risk while leaving the exact percentage and cash constraint unspecified.

assumptions.choice: Use the floating-point value immediately below the Order Block break candle low.
assumptions.reason: No instrument tick size is supplied, while the stop is explicitly required below that low.

assumptions.choice: Enter after a valid signal even if no FVG is currently above entry; submit the take-profit when a later recorded FVG above the filled entry becomes available.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires entry on the Order Block break and does not authorize rejecting otherwise valid entries when the next target FVG has not yet formed.
